reason: The primitive-cubic metric (a about 6.1847 A) is strongly established, and Z=4 is density/composition-plausible, but the submitted exact structures are not. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trajectory optimized a custom residual on only 27 merged cubic line intensities rather than demonstrating a full-profile fit. The selected P1 realization uses about 81 independent positional degrees of freedom for those 27 shell intensities, so its symmetry and coordinates are severely underdetermined; materially different low-symmetry arrangements can plausibly fit the same merged data. It is also chemically dubious, with 22 V-O contacts below 1.60 A (minimum 1.380 A) and 14 O-O contacts below 2.00 A. The Pm-3m parent alternative fits the extracted intensities substantially worse and has 1.592 A O-O contacts, so it neither validates the average framework nor covers the unresolved structural ambiguity. A further attempt using chemically constrained alternative frameworks/symmetries and a reproducible whole-pattern comparison is warranted.
